title: Fund a real account
body: Every operator we score is tested on a funded account under a real identity, not a demo or affiliate sandbox.

title: Time the withdrawal
body: We record wall-clock time from withdrawal request to funds landing on-chain, across at least three separate withdrawals.

title: Check RTP in-client
body: Where a studio licenses multiple configurations, we read the paytable inside the operator's own game client rather than trusting the studio's headline figure.

title: Score against fixed criteria
body: Every operator is scored against the same six weighted criteria — see Criteria below — so scores are comparable across the index.
